reference: A_gbm (frozen global GBM, score-only re-implementation; the production GBM cannot run on this universe)
rule: eligible only with: paired log-loss interval entirely < 0 against A_gbm AND against the tuned league-blind control A_gbm_tuned (and, for over/under and BTTS, the train-rate baseline), Brier better, raw ECE not worse by more than the margin, accuracy not rising while log loss worsens, a tier allowing local models, a non-zero local weight for the blend, and (1X2) not significantly worse than the existing Elo
